title: What eats the plants around your colony (re-taken on today's main)
question: Is this the thing you saw when you reported that absorbing destroys plants - a circle thinned out like B? And was the speed dial up at the time?
context_md:
**This replaces card `20260914T043140244Z-b56729`, which I posted an hour ago and which you should ignore.** That pair was rendered before `claude/thicket-founding` landed on main. Its repair - a floor of plants is a floor a colony can stand on - changes where ants can stand, and it moved the numbers a long way: the colony used to cost **half** the garden and on today's main it costs about **a sixth**. The old picture was more dramatic than the code now is, and I would rather you judged the code you have.

Same world, same seed, same 3000 player ticks, speed x8, one circle. The ONLY difference between A and B is whether a colony is standing in it.

I still could not reproduce your report from the `F` key. Pressing `F` leaves the world **bit-identical** - every plant material, every organism, every death cause, every unit of plant eaten - and that held again after today's merge, with 10 presses drawing 481 power. The energy motes never touch the world; they are painted into the finished frame.

What does eat the garden is **ants grazing inside a circle, multiplied by the speed dial**. Absorbing is upstream of it rather than the cause: it buys the power that keeps the circle standing, and you have to be standing in the colony to press `F` at all.

If B is not what you saw, tell me what was on screen instead - I would rather know my reproduction is wrong than ship a fix for it.
